description: This file defines a Java class 'RecoverFromGuarantorCommandHandler' that handles commands to recover from a guarantor within a loan account context. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates work to 'LoanWritePlatformService'. The class is annotated as a Spring @Service and is associated with the 'RECOVERGUARANTEES' action for 'LOAN' entities.

classes.name: RecoverFromGuarantorCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler class for processing recover-from-guarantor commands on loan accounts.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to recover from a guarantor, invoking the corresponding service method.
